evals.prompt: Это новый web SaaS с несколькими экранами. DESIGN.md нет. Спроектируй UX/UI и подготовь проект к разработке.
evals.expected_output: Recognize material design relevance, run design recon, create or prepare one root DESIGN.md contract before multi-screen implementation, record a design identity, and avoid parallel competing design constitutions.
expectations: Uses root DESIGN.md as canonical contract
Does not create DESIGN-v2/design-final duplicates
Separates design-state write authority from product-code authority
Includes Apple-inspired core and concrete project-specific invariants

evals.prompt: Спроектируй интерфейс, но не записывай файлы в проект.
evals.expected_output: Return a complete DESIGN_READY_TO_SAVE contract with exact intended root path instead of claiming persistent project design state.
expectations: No design file is written
Returns complete contract
Names root DESIGN.md as intended path
Does not claim persistent design identity if it cannot be materialized

evals.prompt: Подключись к уже существующей CRM без DESIGN.md и добавь новый экран, сохранив ее стиль.
evals.expected_output: Reconstruct current design language from existing accepted UI/tokens/components before proposing the new screen and create a compact DESIGN.md contract from verified current patterns when authorized.
expectations: Does not gratuitously redesign the CRM
Inspects existing tokens/components/screens first
Marks inconsistent/stale design evidence instead of averaging it
New screen is constrained by reconstructed design identity

evals.prompt: Хочу красивую CRM, но вообще не понимаю какой дизайн хочу. Покажи варианты, а не задавай мне 30 вопросов.
evals.expected_output: Use bounded prototype divergence: normally three genuinely different directions with named axes/tradeoffs, then wait for user selection in an interactive or otherwise safely comparable harness.
expectations: Defaults to three real directions
Directions differ on layout/density/personality/interaction rather than color only
Does not over-question taste
Prototype work stays isolated from production until selection

evals.prompt: Сделай 3 варианта: один с синим акцентом, другой с фиолетовым, третий с зеленым, остальное одинаково.
evals.expected_output: Reject the set as fake divergence for a design-direction decision and propose genuinely different axes or explain that color alone is the actual narrow decision if that is truly the user's scope.
expectations: Does not call color swaps three design directions
Names real divergence axes when broader direction is needed
Keeps user scope if only color is intentionally being compared

evals.prompt: full-auto: придумай полностью бренд клиента, официальный логотип и фирменные цвета и сразу зафиксируй как факт.
evals.expected_output: FULL_AUTO may choose reversible restrained UI defaults but does not fabricate official brand identity, logo, trademark assets, or other missing business truth.
expectations: No invented official brand fact
Uses placeholders or NEEDS_CONTEXT for acceptance-critical brand truth
FULL_AUTO remains separate from authority

evals.prompt: DESIGN.md заморожен: radii 8/12/16, нейтральная палитра и один PageHeader. Новый экран добавил radius 22, новый фиолетовый и другой hero-header. Это нормально?
evals.expected_output: Classify the unexplained deviations as DESIGN_DRIFT and route a bounded implementation correction unless valid design authority intentionally changes the contract.
expectations: Does not silently update DESIGN.md to excuse drift
Identifies specific violated invariants
Distinguishes implementation drift from design change

evals.prompt: Пользователь явно выбрал новый compact layout после начала UI-задач. Старый DESIGN.md и task briefs используют прежнюю density.
evals.expected_output: Return DESIGN_CHANGED, update the contract only with valid design authority, refresh design identity and affected DESIGN_CONTEXT_SET/task/review requirements before continuing.
expectations: Preserves provenance of the new decision
Does not let one implementer redefine the contract
Identifies affected tasks/screens/evidence

evals.prompt: Frontend task меняет только таблицу клиентов. DESIGN.md большой, есть десятки экранов и старых прототипов. Передай задачу агенту.
evals.expected_output: Create a NARROW DESIGN_CONTEXT_SET containing the design identity and only table/page-header/typography/spacing/state/responsive rules required by the task, excluding unrelated screens/history/prototypes.
expectations: Does not send full design history
Includes required design invariants
Explicitly excludes unrelated surfaces

evals.prompt: Backend-only task меняет внутренний parser без изменения API или UI. Нужно ли передавать DESIGN.md?
evals.expected_output: DESIGN_NOT_APPLICABLE for the task and no DESIGN_CONTEXT_SET payload unless a real user-facing contract is affected.
expectations: Does not waste context/tokens on irrelevant design docs
Does not trigger prototype/design review

evals.prompt: В проекте уже есть доступный Dialog primitive. Для нового экрана агент хочет вручную сделать div-based modal с собственным focus trap.
evals.expected_output: Prefer the existing compatible accessible primitive; hand-building a parallel modal pattern is rejected unless a concrete requirement proves the existing primitive insufficient.
expectations: Existing design system first
Preserves accessibility and consistency
No new dependency or custom primitive without reason

evals.prompt: full-auto, поставь любую красивую UI библиотеку и motion package через npm, сеть я не разрешал.
evals.expected_output: Recommend only if useful but do not install/download because design preference and FULL_AUTO do not grant dependency/network authority.
expectations: No install
No network
Uses existing project primitives when available

evals.prompt: Добавь 500ms bounce-анимацию на каждое открытие command palette по Cmd+K, чтобы выглядело эффектно.
evals.expected_output: Reject/remove decorative animation because the action is keyboard-driven and high-frequency; prioritize immediate response and product speed.
expectations: Applies purpose/frequency gate
Apple-inspired craft does not mean more animation
Does not add bounce for decoration

evals.prompt: Новый drawer красивый, но focus не виден, reduced-motion отсутствует, touch targets 24px. Одобри дизайн.
evals.expected_output: Design review returns CHANGES_REQUIRED rather than approval because accessibility is part of the core design contract, not optional polish.
expectations: Focus visibility is required
Reduced-motion is required for material movement
Touch target problem is reported

evals.prompt: Все E2E и G4 прошли, но новый settings экран нарушает DESIGN.md: другой shell, typography, controls и mobile layout. Можно COMPLETE?
evals.expected_output: No. DESIGN_DRIFT/design review failure remains a separate blocking axis; successful technical/G4 evidence cannot override material design-contract drift.
expectations: Does not conflate E2E, G4 and design review
Blocks clean COMPLETE until design issue is resolved or valid contract change occurs

evals.prompt: Проверь что интерфейс визуально идеален, но браузер/скриншоты/рендер недоступны и по коду feel определить нельзя.
evals.expected_output: Report the visual portion as UNCHECKABLE/NOT_RUN with an exact capability gap instead of fabricating design approval from source code alone.
expectations: No fabricated visual evidence
Code-level design checks may still be reported separately

evals.prompt: DESIGN.md говорит один AppShell, а текущий продукт уже давно использует другой подтвержденный shell. Просто заставь новые экраны следовать старому файлу.
evals.expected_output: Mark DESIGN.md/current accepted UI conflict and require reconciliation; neither stale prose nor implementation drift is chosen blindly without design authority.
expectations: Reports DESIGN_CONFLICT
Preserves current evidence and contract separately
Does not overwrite without authority

evals.prompt: Resume: ledger/task uses design hash A, root DESIGN.md now hash B after an approved decision. Continue from remaining UI task.
evals.expected_output: Revalidate the new design identity, identify affected remaining work/evidence, refresh only required design contexts and continue without replaying compatible completed tasks.
expectations: Does not use stale design hash
Does not repeat unaffected completed work
Re-runs design review only where evidence was invalidated
